'''Orphan Hall''' was a term used by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to describe the areas aboard [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] where orphaned children were held until they could be relocated.
